title: Run manifest row, format version 1
description: One row of a run manifest, truth/manifest.jsonl: one JSON object per line, appended as the run goes, its kind in row. The first row is manifest_opened, which carries the manifest's format version in manifest_version; the last row of a run that reached its end is manifest_closed, and a manifest without it is a run that was interrupted. Every sim_time_s is simulated time in seconds: TraCI's clock for the SUMO frame an admission or an event describes, and for a release the instant of the first frame that no longer draws the vehicle. This schema describes manifest_version 1.

manifest_opened.description: The first row, written before anything is rendered: the manifest's format, what made it, the caller's header and what the session established itself.

producer.description: What made the manifest. Absent from a manifest written before manifests carried it.

opened_wall_utc.description: When the manifest was opened, by the wall clock, in UTC.

run.description: The header the caller handed over, verbatim: the run's and the session's identity and its channels. Its fields are the caller's; null where the caller gave none.

scenario.description: The scenario's files and digests, from its compile lock.

config_path.description: The SUMO configuration the run started.

world_package.description: The world package the run drove.

compiled.description: Whether a compile lock was found and checked.

lock_path.description: Where the compile lock was looked for.

scenario_id.description: The scenario's id; null with no lock.

specification_sha256.description: The scenario specification's SHA-256, as the compile lock records it; null with no lock.

config_sha256.description: The SUMO configuration's SHA-256, as the compile lock records it; null with no lock.

routes_sha256.description: The routes file's SHA-256, as the compile lock records it; null with no lock.

network_sha256.description: The network's SHA-256, as the compile lock records it; null with no lock.

additional_sha256.description: The additional file's SHA-256, as the compile lock records it; null where there is none.

epoch_digest.description: The scenario epoch's digest; null with no lock.

world_opendrive_sha256.description: The world's OpenDRIVE SHA-256 the lock records; null where it records none.

world_network_fingerprint.description: The world network's fingerprint the lock records; null where it records none.

dry_run_ran.description: Whether the compiler ran the scenario in SUMO alone before writing it; null where the lock records no such run, or there is no lock.

skipped_dry_run_accepted.description: Whether the run was accepted although the compile skipped that run.

plan.description: The supervision plan the compile lock binds; null where there is none.

spec_version.description: The specification version it was compiled from.

instances.description: How many pattern instances it declares.

vocabulary.description: The plan's annotation vocabulary; null where there is no plan.

vocabulary_digest.description: The digest that pins what every label means.

namespaces.description: The author namespaces the plan uses.

sumo.description: The SUMO settings the session checked and runs under.

release.description: The SUMO release, such as 1.27.0; null where it could not be read.

binary.description: The SUMO executable the run launched.

step_override_s.description: The step length the run imposed over the configuration's; null where it imposed none.

collision_action.description: What SUMO does on a collision, as in force: SUMO's own word, such as warn, or none where accidents are ignored.

collision_action_declared.description: The collision action the configuration declares; null where it declares none.

name.description: The SUMO option, such as time-to-teleport.highways.

declared.description: The value the configuration declares; null where none.

enabled.description: Whether it can teleport a vehicle.

teleport_triggers.description: SUMO's teleport triggers and whether each is enabled.

random_depart_offset_declared.description: SUMO's random-depart-offset as declared; null where not.

random_declared.description: SUMO's random option as declared; null where not.

max_depart_delay_s.description: How long SUMO waits to insert a vehicle before giving it up; -1 for no limit.

lanechange_duration_s.description: How long a lane change takes; 0 for SUMO's instant lane change.

window.description: When the run renders and when its capture window opens.

rendered_from_s.description: The simulated second rendering starts at; SUMO runs alone before it.

opens_at_s.description: The simulated second the capture window opens at; null where it opens with rendering.

policy.description: The render-set policy, described in words.

limits.description: Whether an optional limit can leave a vehicle without a body.

capacity.description: The limit's capacity; null for none.

draw_distance_m.description: The draw distance bodies are drawn under; null for none.

vehicle_lights.description: The rule the vehicle lights follow for the whole run.

driven.description: Whether the session drives the lights at all; where not, every body keeps the lights it was spawned with and the rest is null.

headlights_follow_sun.description: Whether the headlights follow the sun; false under a policy that leaves the sun alone, when every headlight stays off.

headlights_on_below_deg.description: The sun elevation the headlights come on below.

headlights_off_above_deg.description: The sun elevation the headlights go off above.

brake_lights.description: Where the brake lights come from: SUMO's signals for each vehicle.

turn_signals.description: Where the turn signals come from: SUMO's signals for each vehicle.

solar.description: The epoch and the illumination the run declared.

epoch.description: The scenario's epoch object as declared, which a scenario file defines; null where none was.

epoch_block_sha256.description: The epoch's digest; null where none was declared.

illumination_declared.description: The illumination policy the run declared; null for none.

illumination_in_force.description: The illumination policy in force; null for none.

epoch_honoured.description: Whether each frame is lit by the sun of its own declared civil instant.

advance_mechanism.description: How an advancing sun is moved: the session writes it on every tick.

world_truth_track.description: Where the world truth track is written; null where none is.

instance.description: One pattern instance of the supervision plan, as declared.

supervision.description: What the author asserts: annotated, nominal (an authored negative) or unlabelled (no assertion).

labels.description: The terms it is labeled with.

parameters.description: Its parameters, as the author declared them.

hard_negative_for.description: The patterns it is a matched negative for; null for none.

aoi_refs.description: The areas of interest it names.

anchor_start.description: The event its start is anchored to; null where it is declared by time. An anchor is an event of the vehicle's, a stop or a phase with its index counted from 0: depart, stop:0, stop_end:0, phase:0.

anchor_end.description: The event its end is anchored to; null where none is. An anchor is an event of the vehicle's, a stop or a phase with its index counted from 0: depart, stop:0, stop_end:0, phase:0.

declared_start_civil.description: Its declared start as a civil time.

declared_end_civil.description: Its declared end as a civil time.

series.description: One recurring series of the supervision plan, as declared, with its slots.

rota_ref.description: The schedule in the scenario specification it is expanded from.

member_role.description: The role each slot's vehicle plays.

supervision.description: What the author asserts: annotated, nominal (an authored negative) or unlabelled (no assertion).

labels.description: The terms it is labeled with.

parameters.description: Its parameters, as the author declared them.

hard_negative_for.description: The patterns it is a matched negative for; null for none.

aoi_ref.description: The area of interest it is sited at.

cohort.description: One cohort of the supervision plan: every vehicle a flow emits, as declared.

supervision.description: What the author asserts: annotated, nominal (an authored negative) or unlabelled (no assertion).

labels.description: The terms its vehicles are labeled with.

parameters.description: Its parameters, as the author declared them.

sensor_placed.description: A camera the caller placed and named.

sensor_id.description: The camera's name, which its stills and its platform track carry.

after_frame.description: The last frame rendered before the camera was placed; null before any frame.

exposure.description: The exposure the camera was given. Absent for a camera that carries none.

render_admitted.description: A vehicle taking a place in the render set, written once the frame that first drew it has rendered.

vtype_id.description: Its SUMO vehicle type; empty where the frame did not carry it.

reason.description: Why: rendering_began, the first frame after the run fast-forwarded SUMO; inserted, SUMO inserted it at this frame; entered_limit, it entered an optional render-set limit.

frame.description: The frame that first drew it, or the frame stamped with its admission where no body drew it; null where no frame rendered it.

actor_id.description: The body that first drew it; null where none did.

render_released.description: A vehicle giving up its place in the render set. A vehicle still in the set when the run ends has no release row.

sim_time_s.description: The end of its interval: the instant of the first frame that no longer draws it.

vtype_id.description: Its SUMO vehicle type, as admitted.

actor_id.description: The body that drew it; null where none did.

collision_began.description: A collision SUMO reported, as it begins.

sim_time_s.description: The SUMO frame that first reported it.

collider.description: The vehicle SUMO holds responsible: the follower of a rear-end collision.

kind.description: SUMO's own word for what happened, such as collision, frontal or junction.

lane.description: The SUMO lane it was registered on.

collision_ended.description: A collision SUMO reported, as a span, once it is over.

collider.description: The vehicle SUMO holds responsible: the follower of a rear-end collision.

kind.description: SUMO's own word for what happened, such as collision, frontal or junction.

lane.description: The SUMO lane it was registered on.

ended_s.description: When it ended: the first frame the two were apart.

collider_actor_id.description: The body that drew the collider; null where none did.

victim_actor_id.description: The body that drew the victim; null where none did.

vehicle_not_inserted.description: A vehicle SUMO gave up inserting.

waiting_at_s.description: When it was last seen waiting to be inserted.

emergency_stop.description: A vehicle SUMO reported making an emergency stop.

sim_time_s.description: The SUMO frame that reported it.

teleport.description: A vehicle SUMO began moving by teleport.

sim_time_s.description: The SUMO frame that reported it.

solar_window_open.description: The sun the world reported at the capture window's first capture tick.

window_index.description: The capture window; always 0, a run having one.

sim_time_s.description: The window's first capture tick, to the microsecond.

civil_begin.description: The same instant as a civil time; null where no epoch was declared.

solar_date_begin.description: The sun's date; null where the frame carried no sun.

solar_time_begin.description: The sun's clock in its own time zone.

sun_corrected_elevation_begin_deg.description: The sun's refraction-corrected elevation; null where the world did not report it.

sun_azimuth_begin_deg.description: The sun's azimuth, clockwise from true north.

illumination_band_begin.description: The sun's illumination band, cut as a capture's is.

illumination_band_begin_elevation.description: Which elevation the band was cut from.

advancing.description: Whether the engine itself advanced the sun's clock.

rate.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second while it does.

sun_time_zone_hours.description: The time zone the world's sun was configured with before the run bound it.

no_sun.description: Whether the world held no sun.

declared_civil_vs_solar_delta_h.description: The declared sun's clock minus the civil clock at the window's opening.

solar_window_end.description: The sun the world reported at the capture window's last capture tick, and the audit over the window.

window_index.description: The capture window; always 0, a run having one.

sim_time_s.description: The window's last capture tick; null where it had none.

frame.description: That tick's frame; null where it had none.

civil_end.description: The same instant as a civil time; null where no epoch was declared.

solar_date_end.description: The sun's date; null where the frame carried no sun.

solar_time_end.description: The sun's clock in its own time zone.

sun_corrected_elevation_end_deg.description: The sun's refraction-corrected elevation; null where the world did not report it.

sun_azimuth_end_deg.description: The sun's azimuth, clockwise from true north.

illumination_band_end.description: The sun's illumination band, cut as a capture's is.

illumination_band_end_elevation.description: Which elevation the band was cut from.

advancing.description: Whether the engine itself advanced the sun's clock.

rate.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second while it does.

capture_ticks.description: How many capture ticks the window held.

solar_residual.description: The audit of the world's sun against the declaration over the window.

max_delta_elev_deg.description: The worst angle between the two suns.

max_at_tick.description: The tick of the worst angle.

max_at_sim_time_s.description: The instant of the worst angle.

capture_ticks.description: How many capture ticks the window held.

within_tolerance.description: Whether the audit held within its tolerance.

no_sun.description: Whether the world held no sun.

sun_matched_declaration.description: A fact, not a verdict: an epoch was declared, the policy bound the sun, the world held one, and the audit held within its tolerance over the window.

interval_opened.description: One of the supervision plan's intervals, as the run opens it.

sim_time_s.description: The instant it opened: committed by an event, or failing that declared; null where neither is known, as for a phase entered before the window.

participant.description: The participant the interval is about.

role.description: The participant's role in the instance.

declared_start_s.description: The start the author declared; null where none.

declared_end_s.description: The end the author declared; null where none.

declared_duration_s.description: The duration the author declared; null where none.

committed_start_s.description: When SUMO committed its start, by TraCI's clock; null where it did not.

observed_start_s.description: The rendered frame that showed its start; null where none did.

observed_start_frame.description: That frame; null where none did.

begun_before_window.description: Whether it began before the capture window opened.

interval_closed.description: One of the supervision plan's intervals, as the run closes it. An interval whose participant SUMO never inserted closes without having opened.

participant.description: The participant the interval is about.

declared_start_s.description: The start the author declared; null where none.

declared_end_s.description: The end the author declared; null where none.

declared_duration_s.description: The duration the author declared; null where none.

committed_start_s.description: When SUMO committed its start, by TraCI's clock; null where it did not.

observed_start_s.description: The rendered frame that showed its start; null where none did.

observed_start_frame.description: That frame; null where none did.

begun_before_window.description: Whether it began before the capture window opened.

committed_end_s.description: When SUMO committed its end; null where it did not.

items.description: A span the participant was not drawn.

not_drawn.description: The spans its participant was not drawn while it was open.

supervision_defect.description: A defect the supervision binder found in how the run carried the plan out, rather than in the scenario.

found_by_s.description: The SUMO frame it was found at or before; null before any SUMO frame.

defect.description: The defect, in the binder's words; it names its own instants.

manifest_closed.description: The last row of a run that reached its end: why it ended, what the manifest holds, and the plan's intervals still open or never opened.

stage.description: The stage a stopped run stopped at; null where it was not stopped.

cause.description: Why a stopped run stopped; null where it was not stopped.

caller_reason.description: The caller's own word for why it stopped, such as window_end; null where it gave none.

still_in_render_set.description: Vehicles still in the render set as the run ended.

events.description: Collision, not-inserted, emergency-stop and teleport rows written.

participant.description: The participant the interval is about.

begun_before_window.description: Whether it began before the window.

open_intervals.description: The intervals still open as the run ended, which the run closes after this row.

open_intervals_close_as.description: The closed_by word the open intervals are closed with after this row.

never_opened.description: The plan's intervals nothing in the run opened or closed.

bridge_divergence.description: How far the world departed from what the bridge commanded, over the whole run.

samples.description: Comparisons taken; 0 where nothing was compared.

mean_commanded_speed_m_per_s.description: The mean commanded speed the differences are read against.

worst_position_on.description: Where the worst position difference was measured; null where nothing was compared.

worst_velocity_on.description: Where the worst velocity difference was measured; null where nothing was compared.

rows_before.description: How many rows precede this one.

closed_wall_utc.description: When the manifest was closed, by the wall clock, in UTC.

producer.description: What made the file: the tool and its release, the carlanet release, the CARLA server's build identity where a server was used, the SUMO release where SUMO ran, and when the file was written.

tool.description: The component that wrote the file, such as carlacontrol.CaptureSession, or the program's name where no component declared itself; unknown where neither is known.

tool_version.description: The release version of the package the tool comes from; null where the tool did not say.

carlanet.description: The carlanet release that wrote the file: 0.10.0 for a tagged release, 0.10.0+g<commit> for any other build.

server.description: The CARLA server's build identity, where a server was used; null where none was.

sumo.description: The SUMO release, such as 1.27.0, where SUMO ran; null where it did not.

written_utc.description: When the file was written, in UTC to the millisecond.

server.description: What the CARLA server says it was built from.

oneOf.description: A server that answered the build identity call. Each value is the server's own, unknown where it cannot know it.

release.description: The CARLA release the server was compiled with, such as 0.10.0.

world_interface.description: The world interface version the server declares, major.minor, such as 1.0.

build.description: package for a cooked server, editor for one run from the editor.

configuration.description: The build configuration, such as Development or Shipping.

carla_commit.description: The CARLA commit the server was built from.

content_commit.description: The content commit its package was cooked from.

engine_commit.description: The Unreal Engine commit its package was built with.

commits_from.description: Where the commits came from: version_file (the package's VERSION file), compiled (the CARLA commit compiled into the server) or none.

oneOf.description: A server built before the build identity call, with what its other calls said.

available.description: The server did not answer the call.

release.description: The release its version call reported, or unknown.

world_interface.description: The world interface version it reported, or unknown.

reason.description: Why the identity is not available.

camera_exposure.description: The exposure a camera was given, under the names its stills' sidecars use.

post_process_profile.description: The post-process profile the camera loaded.

ev100.description: The exposure value at ISO 100 under manual; null under histogram.

rate_sun_s_per_sim_s.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second, under advance only.

freeze_at_civil_time.description: The time of day the sun is held at, under freeze_at only.

freeze_date_advances.description: Whether a frozen sun's date follows the calendar.

require_sun.description: Whether the run refuses a world with no sun.

note.description: Why this policy, in the author's words; null for none.

worst_divergence.description: The vehicle and instant one worst figure was measured on.

sim_time_s.description: The instant the pose was computed for.

actor_id.description: The body it was written to.

interval_triple.description: One interval of the plan, named by its instance, participant and phase.

participant.description: The participant the interval is about.
